bullets.text: Check whether this is a random sample or a timed collection; sudden inability to urinate needs urgent care. Look at the rest of the urine report and any burning, fever, pain, or other symptoms before deciding what to do.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: This is often a place for the lab to write additional urine findings rather than one specific biomarker. A catch-all lab field for additional urine findings not listed elsewhere.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: There is no standard “high” result: the meaning depends on the exact finding written by the lab. A urine result can change depending on how the sample was collected and how concentrated it is.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A blank or “none seen” note may simply mean there were no extra findings. One unusual finding does not always mean there is an infection or kidney disease.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Read the exact lab comment; this field has no single medical meaning. Look at the rest of the urine report and any burning, fever, pain, or other symptoms before deciding what to do.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A mineral that helps nerves, muscles, and your heart work properly. Magnesium helps muscles, nerves, and many body processes work normally.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high level may occur when kidneys cannot clear magnesium or from some supplements. Small amounts of nutrients and other substances can affect many body processes.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low level can contribute to cramps, weakness, or heart-rhythm problems. An unusual number may reflect diet, medicines, or another condition and needs context.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Review medicines, kidney function, and symptoms; severe weakness or palpitations need prompt care. Review the result alongside related tests and symptoms before considering supplements or treatment.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A mineral that helps immunity, healing, and normal growth. Zinc helps with healing, growth, taste, and normal immune function.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high level can occur with excess supplements and may lower copper over time. Small amounts of nutrients and other substances can affect many body processes.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low level may affect taste, wound healing, and immunity. An unusual number may reflect diet, medicines, or another condition and needs context.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Interpret with diet, inflammation, and supplement use; avoid high-dose zinc without advice. Review the result alongside related tests and symptoms before considering supplements or treatment.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A substance made when your body processes proteins and certain vitamins. Homocysteine is a substance made as your body processes proteins.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high level can occur with low B12, folate, B6, kidney changes, or inherited factors. Small amounts of nutrients and other substances can affect many body processes.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low level usually is not a concern. An unusual number may reflect diet, medicines, or another condition and needs context.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Look at B12, folate, and kidney results; lowering the number alone is not proven to prevent heart disease. Review the result alongside related tests and symptoms before considering supplements or treatment.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A sensitive test for inflammation that can also help assess heart risk in the right setting. This is a sensitive blood test for a protein that increases when your body has inflammation.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A higher result can mean inflammation from an infection, injury, or other cause. Inflammation is one way your body responds to illness or injury.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result generally means less inflammation at the time of testing. This test cannot show where the problem is or prove a particular disease.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Do not assess heart risk from hs-CRP during an infection; interpret with overall risk factors. Compare with symptoms, other tests, and whether the result stays raised.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A broad sign of inflammation in the body, but it cannot tell exactly where or why. This test checks how quickly red blood cells settle in a tube, which can change with inflammation.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur with infection, inflammation, anemia, or many other causes. Inflammation is one way your body responds to illness or injury.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result is usually not worrying. This test cannot show where the problem is or prove a particular disease.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Read with symptoms and other results; ESR does not diagnose a particular illness. Compare with symptoms, other tests, and whether the result stays raised.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A hormone important for sexual function, muscle, and other body processes; normal ranges differ greatly by sex and age. Testosterone is a hormone involved in sexual development, muscle, and other body functions.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high level can have different causes, including supplements or hormone conditions, depending on sex. Hormone levels may change through the day, with age, and at different stages of life.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low level can relate to symptoms or health conditions, but one result is not a diagnosis. The sampling time and personal situation can matter as much as the number.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Morning timing, age, sex, medicines, and repeat testing matter. Check the test timing, medicines, symptoms, and any relevant reproductive or endocrine history with a clinician.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A hormone that helps your body respond to stress and manage energy. Cortisol is a hormone that helps your body respond to stress and manage blood sugar and energy.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur with stress, medicines, or certain hormone conditions. Hormone levels may change through the day, with age, and at different stages of life.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result can occur with adrenal problems or steroid medicine effects. The sampling time and personal situation can matter as much as the number.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: The time of day and type of test are essential; do not interpret one cortisol result alone. Check the test timing, medicines, symptoms, and any relevant reproductive or endocrine history with a clinician.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A hormone from the brain that helps control ovaries or testes. LH is a hormone that sends signals to the ovaries or testes.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result may reflect menopause, low function of ovaries or testes, or normal cycle timing. Hormone levels may change through the day, with age, and at different stages of life.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result may occur when the brain sends less hormone signal. The sampling time and personal situation can matter as much as the number.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Interpret with sex, age, menstrual cycle stage, FSH, and related hormones. Check the test timing, medicines, symptoms, and any relevant reproductive or endocrine history with a clinician.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A hormone from the brain that helps regulate egg development or sperm production. FSH is a hormone that helps control egg development or sperm production.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur in menopause or when ovaries or testes are making fewer hormones. Hormone levels may change through the day, with age, and at different stages of life.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result may happen when the brain sends less hormone signal. The sampling time and personal situation can matter as much as the number.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Timing in the menstrual cycle and other hormone results matter. Check the test timing, medicines, symptoms, and any relevant reproductive or endocrine history with a clinician.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: A hormone best known for supporting milk production after childbirth. Prolactin is a hormone best known for helping the body make breast milk.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur with pregnancy, some medicines, stress, or pituitary conditions. Hormone levels may change through the day, with age, and at different stages of life.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result is usually not important unless assessing certain pituitary problems. The sampling time and personal situation can matter as much as the number.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Check medicines, pregnancy where relevant, and whether a repeat morning sample is advised. Check the test timing, medicines, symptoms, and any relevant reproductive or endocrine history with a clinician.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: An enzyme that leaks into the blood when muscles are strained or injured. CK is an enzyme that can leak into the blood when muscles are strained or injured.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur after hard exercise, muscle injury, or certain medicines; very high levels can harm kidneys. These substances can rise when cells are stressed or damaged.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result is usually not a concern. Exercise, medicines, and sample-related issues may also affect the result.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: If you have severe muscle pain, weakness, or cola-colored urine, seek urgent care. Review symptoms, recent exercise, and any related blood tests with a clinician. Severe muscle pain, weakness, or dark urine needs urgent assessment.

bullets.label: What it is
bullets.text: An enzyme found throughout the body that can rise when cells are damaged. LDH is found in many body cells, so a high result does not point to just one organ.

bullets.label: If high or positive
bullets.text: A high result can occur for many reasons, including tissue injury or even sample handling. These substances can rise when cells are stressed or damaged.

bullets.label: If low or negative
bullets.text: A low result is usually not important. Exercise, medicines, and sample-related issues may also affect the result.

bullets.label: What to do next
bullets.text: Look at symptoms and other tests; LDH alone cannot show which organ is affected. Review symptoms, recent exercise, and any related blood tests with a clinician.
